title: City Councilman Threatens Officers’ Jobs During OWI Arrest
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On August 14, 2022, an officer conducted a traffic stop on a vehicle after observing its brake light out in Menomonie, WI. The driver possessed a strong odor of intoxicants, glassy eyes, and slurred speech. After several tests and a PBT, it was determined the driver was not safe to drive. During the arrest, the man claimed he was a city councilman. He would frequently intimidate and threaten the officers’ jobs due to their decision of his arrest.

More info on the arrest:
https://www.wqow.com/news/crime/menomonie-city-councilman-cited-for-owi-allegedly-threatened-officers-jobs-during-arrest/article_5a51edc0-23e3-11ed-bfd9-47f1aca913e2.html

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public. 

💥Want to see more content?
